race.description: Equimillion 2026- October Long Weekend Super Mdn Plate
race.comment: Competitive maiden with loads of chances. DR KNOW (7) has showed ability in his two runs to date. Raced handy then had a lot of trouble finding clear galloping room before finishing a forgivable fifth over 1250m at Canterbury last start. Like him back on a bigger track. Great chance to break through. ZYNARO (10) led and held on okay for third when resuming over 1200m at Wyong two back. Pulled up with respiratory issues last start so put a pen through that run. Very fit and should be prominent for a long way. ALL OVER HARRY (5) resumes. Was in the market but did nothing at his only appearance to date back in May at Randwick. Has been gelded and a recent trial was encouraging. Expecting much more this prep. AREESEA (6) has settled back in the field then attacked the line with gusto at her two runs this prep, both over shorter distances. Gets things to suit today so she poses a serious threat.
